scripts.ideaTitle: The Only 3 Denim Fits You Need in 2026
scripts.hook: Throw out your skinny jeans. In 2026, your entire rotation only needs these 3 denim fits.
slides: Fit #1: The Ultra-Baggy Statement. Stacked at the ankles with a wide-leg puddle drop. Pair with cropped boxy tees and chunky sneakers for max proportions.
Fit #2: The Tailored Straight-Leg. The most versatile middle ground. Sits clean on the shoe with a slight break. Perfect for smart-casual and everyday wear.
Fit #3: The Relaxed Vintage Wash. Mid-rise with a looser thigh and slight taper. Looks broken-in on day one and goes with literally every jacket you own.
Rule of thumb for 2026: Balance your top and bottom silhouettes. Baggy denim means fitted or cropped tops; straight-leg means effortless layering.
